PGSp_outer_involution.description: one degree-36 sheet is fixed and the other two are swapped

centralizer_boundary: Because a degree-36 representative stabilizer fixes exactly one spread, the corresponding transitive PSp G-set has no nontrivial G-equivariant relabeling fixing the chosen stabilizer chart.
theorem: The three degree-36 half-spinor PSp-orbits are three genuine copies of the same 36-spread G-set. PGSp realizes a concrete transposition on the three-copy fiber, but not a transitive S3 action by itself.
verification: Independently recomputed in this run from the 270 maximal singular generators, exact W33 spread enumeration and the PSp/PGSp actions.
boundary: This is finite G-set transport. A full ambient S3 on the three sheets requires an additional order-three automorphism and is not inferred here from the copy count.
